def solve():
    conductivity = step_247(resistance=1 / G, cell_constant=G_star / 100)['conductivity']
    molar_conductivity = step_248(conductivity=conductivity, molarity=C)['molar_conductivity']
    limiting_molar_conductivity = find(step_251, "limiting_molar_conductivity", result=alpha, molar_conductivity=molar_conductivity)
    return limiting_molar_conductivity / 10000
